name: Share Everywhere

suggests.drupal/commerce: Display social buttons on Commerce product pages.
suggests.drupal/markdown: Render the module README on its help page.

project_description:
Synopsis 
 The Share Everywhere module was mainly created for those, who make custom websites and need the social buttons to fit into their design instead of the default buttons of social sites. These can be inserted as images or with your custom CSS code too. Included buttons: Facebook like and share, Twitter, LinkedIn, Facebook Messenger, Viber, WhatsApp, Copy site URL (new) .

 Differences to other modules 
 
 Support for Drupal Commerce 
 Easily configurable, fits to any website structure 
 It handles the Facebook like button very well, which means that it doesn't mess up your design 
 With front-end skills, it is easily customizable 
 You can turn off the styling and write your own CSS using the included SASS file 
 
 Other features 
 
 Rearrange the order of the buttons (new) 
 Easily scalable SVG icons 
 Available as a block 
 Display in articles, pages, teasers, custom nodes and commerce product pages 
 
 Recommended modules 
 
 
 Drupal Commerce :

 When this module is enabled, you will have the option to display social buttons on product pages.
 
 
 Markdown Filter :

 When this module is enabled, display of the project's README.md will be rendered with the markdown filter when you visit admin/help/share_everywhere .
